## Predicting whether a promise will be kept

- 1121 resolved promises, 43% fully kept
- Leave-one-company-out AUC **0.654** (90% CI [0.625, 0.682]); company Say-Do score alone 0.5334; Brier 0.225 vs base rate 0.247
- Walk-forward (train on outcomes public before 2025-07-18, n=189; test on later promises, n=562): AUC **0.648** (90% CI [0.612, 0.687]); score-only 0.55; Brier 0.230 vs 0.253

Top coefficients (positive = more likely kept):

- `cat_high_base` +1.03
- `horizon_yrs` +1.00
- `margin_gap` -0.95
- `ops_spread` +0.65
- `cat_low_base` -0.48
- `muse_forecast_logit` +0.41
- `n_hedges` +0.35
- `dir_range_or_at_least` +0.35
- `sec_prepared` +0.34
- `has_conditions` -0.33

## Market test (point-in-time, excess vs equal-weight universe)

- 135 call-events, 32 companies: top-tercile Say-Do -0.42% vs bottom -1.45% over 90 days; spread +1.03% (90% CI [-6.98, 9.48]); mean quarterly rank IC 0.003
- Event study (60d): kept revealed +1.19% (n=154), broken revealed -1.03% (n=139), diff +2.22% (90% CI [-0.89, 5.39])

Intervals that include zero mean the test is inconclusive at this sample size.
